home.subtitle: Mapped hiking routes, waterfalls, lakes and summits — from the Greater Caucasus to the Talysh hills. Every fact links back to its open-data source.
home.featuredDescription: Routes traced by the OpenStreetMap community, measured from the map and profiled with satellite elevation data.

home.regionsDescription: Azerbaijan's 14 economic regions. Pick one to see its trails and places.

home.mapDescription: Trace mapped trails, spot waterfalls and peaks nearby, and open any point in Google Maps for directions.
home.ecoTitle: Leave it better than you found it
home.ecoDescription: Azerbaijan's wild places are fragile and getting more visitors. Small habits keep them beautiful for the next hiker — and for the villages that live alongside them.

eco.title: Pack it out
eco.text: Carry out every wrapper and bottle — and one piece of someone else's litter.

eco.title: Refill at springs
eco.text: Bring a bottle and refill where locals do instead of buying plastic.

eco.title: Stay on the path
eco.text: Shortcuts erode slopes and meadows that take years to recover.

eco.title: Buy local
eco.text: Honey, cheese and tea from village families keep tourism money in the mountains.

challenges.intro: Small, doable challenges that protect the places we love. Take them on alone or with friends — progress tracking and badges will come with EcoTrail accounts.

items.title: Pack out one extra
items.text: On every hike, carry out at least one piece of litter that isn't yours.

items.title: Zero plastic bottles
items.text: Complete three hikes with only a refillable bottle.

items.title: Stay on the path
items.text: No shortcuts across switchbacks or meadows for a whole season.

items.title: Village-to-table
items.text: Buy lunch or supplies from a family in the village where your hike starts.

items.title: Low-carbon trailhead
items.text: Reach a trailhead by shared taxi, bus or train instead of a private car.

items.title: No-trace camp
items.text: Camp overnight without an open fire and leave the pitch exactly as you found it.

items.title: Trail reporter
items.text: Report a damaged sign, blocked path or illegal dumping with a photo and location.

items.title: Map a new trail
items.text: Share a trail that isn't on EcoTrail yet — or add it to OpenStreetMap.

items.title: Clean-up day
items.text: Join or organise a group litter pick on a popular trail.

challenges.lntTitle: The seven principles of Leave No Trace
challenges.lntIntro: An internationally used framework for enjoying the outdoors responsibly. Every EcoTrail challenge builds on one of them.
lnt: Travel and camp on durable surfaces

sources.title: Sources & credits
sources.intro: EcoTrail only shows facts we can trace back to an open source. Here's where the data comes from and how it's licensed.
sources.photosIntro: Photos come from Wikimedia Commons contributors and are used under the licences shown with each image. Place photos are credited on their pages.
method: Distance is measured along the mapped OpenStreetMap line.
Elevation comes from SRTM 30 m samples roughly every 250 m; ascent ignores changes under 5 m to damp noise.
Walking time uses Tobler's hiking function over the elevation profile.
Difficulty uses the SAC scale when mapped; otherwise distance plus 1 km per 100 m of ascent (under 10 easy, under 20 moderate, under 35 hard).
